turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Delhi?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Sameer from the RBI regional compliance office. Your bank account KYC has expired and we have received a notice to freeze it by tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Freeze it? But I did everything last year, I think.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is a new government mandate for senior citizens, and your file is still pending. If it is not updated, you will not be able to withdraw any money.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh dear, I have some payments to make. What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, I can do it for you right now over the phone. I just need to verify your identity first.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is this safe? Should I come to the branch instead?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The branch will take three days, and your account will be blocked. Just tell me your Aadhaar number and the sixteen digit card number to start.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, I have my card here. It is 4532... no, let me find my glasses.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, Mrs. Iyer. Once I enter the card details, a verification code of twenty five thousand rupees will be triggered to confirm your limit, and you will get it back immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? Why is such a large amount involved?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a technical check for the KYC portal. Now please read out the OTP you just received on your mobile.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure about this, it sounds very strange.
